name: Food poisoning / contamination outbreak
description: Cross-contamination, temperature breach, or supplier issue causes a customer outbreak. Closure + compensation + reputational damage.

name: Allergen reaction in customer
description: Allergen-mislabel or cross-contamination causes a serious or fatal reaction. Criminal liability under EU FIC / Natasha's Law.

name: Loss of premises / alcohol licence
description: Repeated breaches, complaints, or noise issues trigger licensing review and revocation.

name: Cash / tip theft and shrinkage
description: Staff or insider theft from cash drawer, tip pool, or end-of-night cash drop. Compounds with tax under-reporting.
